finding: Initial focus is set to the first focusable light DOM element, but the shadow DOM close button is excluded from _getFocusableElements(). If no light DOM content is focusable, the dialog opens with no focus target and the close button is unreachable via the focus trap.
suggestion: Include the shadow DOM close button in the focusable elements list as a fallback: if (lightFocusable.length === 0) { const closeBtn = this.shadowRoot?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.dialog__close-btn'); if (closeBtn) lightFocusable.push(closeBtn); }

finding: Focus trap only tracks light DOM elements in _cachedFocusableElements. When Shift+Tab is pressed and activeElement is the shadow DOM close button (resolves to the host), the trap logic cannot match it against the first/last element, causing focus to escape the modal dialog.
suggestion: Add the shadow close button to the cached focusable list, or check shadowRoot.activeElement when currentActive does not match first/last.

finding: The drawer uses a <div role='dialog'> instead of the native <dialog> element. The _hideBackgroundFromScreenReaders method relies on iterating document.body.children which may miss elements in deep shadow trees.
suggestion: Consider using the native <dialog> element with showModal() for better browser-native accessibility support, or add tests confirming screen reader behavior.
statusReason: requires architectural change to native dialog element

finding: When noHeader is true, the drawer has no visible close mechanism. The Escape key still works, but there is no visible UI affordance for mouse/touch users to close the drawer.
suggestion: When noHeader is true, either render a visually hidden close button that remains accessible, or document that consumers MUST provide their own close mechanism.

finding:
The title element uses

tag with id for aria-labelledby. A

tag is semantically a paragraph, not a heading.
suggestion:
Change

to

for stronger semantic heading within the dialog landmark.

finding: aria-hidden is set to the string 'false' when visible. Some screen readers treat the explicit string 'false' differently from attribute absence.
suggestion: Change aria-hidden from 'true'/'false' to use Lit's nothing directive to remove the attribute when visible.

finding: When the popover opens, focus is moved to the body element unconditionally. For non-interactive popovers, stealing focus from the trigger is unexpected and may disorient screen reader users.
suggestion: Only move focus into the popover body when it contains interactive elements.

finding: For hover-triggered popovers, content dismisses on mouseleave with no delay. WCAG 1.4.13 requires hoverable content remain visible while pointer is over it. Fast pointer movements between anchor and body may cause flicker dismissal.
suggestion: Add a small hide delay (100-200ms) for hover-triggered popovers to prevent premature dismissal.

finding: hx-popup is a positioning primitive with no ARIA semantics. Accessibility contract is documented, delegating all ARIA responsibility to consumers. Inert attribute correctly applied when inactive. No violations.
suggestion: none

finding: The shadow DOM tooltip div's id duplicates the light DOM span's id, which could cause ID conflicts if both are in the same document scope.
suggestion: Use a different ID for the shadow DOM tooltip element to avoid potential ID collisions.

finding: Auto-dismiss timer is disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is active, but NOT when the toast has interactive content. A 3-second default duration may be too short for users with cognitive disabilities in healthcare contexts.
suggestion: Increase the default duration to at least 5000ms. Pause the timer when the toast contains an action slot. For closable toasts with actions, require explicit user dismissal.

finding: The close button renders at ~24px. This is below the 44x44px minimum touch target required by WCAG 2.5.5 and the healthcare mandate.
suggestion: Add min-width and min-height of var(--hx-touch-target-min, 2.75rem) to the .toast__close CSS.

finding: The dropdown panel has no role attribute. The trigger sets aria-haspopup='menu' but the panel itself does not have role='menu', creating a disconnect where AT announces a menu popup but cannot find the menu landmark.
suggestion: Add role='menu' to the panel element.

finding: The panel uses aria-hidden='false' as an explicit string value when visible. Should use Lit's nothing directive to remove the attribute.
suggestion: Change aria-hidden to use nothing when visible instead of the string 'false'.

finding: The panel has no aria-label or aria-labelledby. A menu must have an accessible name per WCAG 4.1.2.
suggestion: Add a label property and apply it to the panel: aria-label=${this.label || 'Menu'}.

finding: aria-expanded is removed via nothing when closed. Per APG Menu Button pattern, aria-expanded should be 'false' when closed, not absent.
suggestion: Change aria-expanded to use String(this._open) so it reads 'false' when closed.

finding: The 'sm' size trigger button is 2rem (32px) and 'md' is 2.5rem (40px), both below the 44x44px minimum touch target required by the healthcare mandate.
suggestion: Add min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px to both sm and md trigger sizes, or add invisible touch target padding.

finding: hx-menu implements a compliant APG Menu pattern: role='menu', role='menuitem'/'menuitemcheckbox'/'menuitemradio', roving tabindex, arrow key navigation, typeahead, and Escape. No violations.
suggestion: none

finding: Error div with role='alert' and aria-atomic='true' is always rendered in the DOM even when no error exists. Empty role='alert' containers can cause screen readers to announce blank content on mount.
suggestion: Conditionally render the error div only when hasError is true, or use role='status' to reduce verbosity when empty.

finding: Help text container is conditionally rendered only when helpText or _hasHelpTextSlot is true and no error, but the fallback branch still renders the slot without the wrapping div with id. Dynamic slot help text may not have proper aria-describedby reference.
suggestion: Ensure the help-text container with the ID is always rendered when _hasHelpTextSlot is true.

finding: Character counter has aria-live='polite' and updates on every render. Combined with the debounced _liveAnnouncement region, users could hear redundant announcements near the character limit.
suggestion: Remove aria-live from the visible counter div since the hidden live region already provides debounced announcements.

finding: The label @click and input @click/@keydown handlers create a potential double-toggle risk if the browser dispatches both a click and a keydown-triggered synthetic click with assistive technology.
suggestion: Handle change at the input level via the native change event rather than intercepting click on the wrapping label.

finding: Error container uses role='status' with ?hidden attribute binding. When hidden is removed, the status region may not announce its content because the content was already present before the region became visible.
suggestion: Inject error text into the live region only after the container becomes visible to force re-announcement.

finding: The describedBy computation only includes _helpTextId when _hasHelpSlot is true, but never checks for a helpText property. If helpText is set via property, the group lacks an aria-describedby reference.
suggestion: Add a helpText property check to the describedBy computation.

finding: The describedBy logic uses a ternary that prevents combining error AND help text IDs. Screen readers cannot read both error and help text simultaneously.
suggestion: Use array-filter-join pattern: [hasError ? this._errorId : null, helpText ? this._helpTextId : null].filter(Boolean).join(' ')

finding: When label is empty, aria-labelledby is omitted. The fieldset has no accessible name fallback.
suggestion: Add a devWarn when label is empty and support aria-label as a fallback.

finding: Slotted error content replaces the internal error div, breaking the aria-describedby reference to _errorId.
suggestion: Wrap the error slot in a persistent container that always carries the _errorId.

finding: aria-disabled is always set via String(this.disabled) producing 'false' for non-disabled radios. Verbose but not harmful.
suggestion: Use conditional setAttribute/removeAttribute pattern instead of String(this.disabled).

finding: The hx-radio label span has no explicit association with the radio role on the host element. No explicit aria-label or aria-labelledby to guarantee the accessible name.
suggestion: Add aria-label on the host from the label property, or verify shadow DOM text content flows as accessible name with screen reader testing.

finding: Unselected options in single-select listbox have aria-selected='false'. Per ARIA spec, unselected options in single-select should omit aria-selected.
suggestion: Use aria-selected=${isSelected ? 'true' : nothing} for single-select.

finding: hasError only checks !!this.error, not _hasErrorSlot. Slotted error content without error property won't trigger aria-invalid.
suggestion: Change to: const hasError = !!this.error || this._hasErrorSlot;

finding: In multi-select mode, unselected options use nothing instead of aria-selected='false'. Multi-select listbox should explicitly set aria-selected='false' on unselected options.
suggestion: When this.multiple is true, use aria-selected=${isSelected ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: Slotted help text replaces the internal div with id=_helpId, breaking the aria-describedby reference from the input.
suggestion: Wrap the slot in a persistent container that carries the _helpId.

finding: The fallback aria-label='Slider' is generic and does not describe what the slider controls. Insufficient for healthcare context.
suggestion: Require a meaningful label and issue a stronger warning.

finding: No aria-label fallback when no label property or slot is provided.
suggestion: Add aria-label fallback or devWarn when no label is provided.

finding: aria-valuenow/min/max are set on a native input[type=number] which already exposes these semantics natively. May cause duplicate announcements.
suggestion: Remove aria-valuenow/min/max from the native number input. If spinbutton semantics needed, add role='spinbutton' explicitly.

finding: aria-selected on day buttons only renders when isSelected is true. In a grid pattern, all cells should have explicit aria-selected for consistent screen reader announcements.
suggestion: Use aria-selected=${isSelected ? 'true' : 'false'} on all day buttons.

finding: Trigger button aria-expanded uses nothing when closed. Should be 'false' per APG dialog-trigger pattern.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${this._isOpen ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: aria-controls on combobox input is only set when listbox is open. When listbox is removed from DOM, the dangling reference is a spec violation.
suggestion: Always render the listbox (with hidden attribute when closed) and always set aria-controls.

finding: describedBy only includes _helpId when _hasHelpSlot is true. helpText set via attribute is not checked.
suggestion: Add helpText property check: (this.helpText || this._hasHelpSlot) ? this._helpId : null

finding: When the color picker popover opens, focus is not programmatically moved to the panel. User must Tab to discover the panel content.
suggestion: After _show(), move focus to the first interactive element in the panel.

finding: Trigger button aria-expanded uses nothing when closed. Should be 'false' per APG.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${this._open ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: Error div uses both role='alert' and aria-live='polite'. role='alert' implies aria-live='assertive', creating a contradictory combination.
suggestion: Remove aria-live='polite' since role='alert' already provides assertive semantics.

finding: Assertive live region for drag-over feedback may interrupt screen reader users reading other content.
suggestion: Consider using aria-live='polite' instead of 'assertive' for drag-over announcement.

finding: In readonly mode, aria-label uses hardcoded 'Rating:' prefix. Custom label property would create redundant labels.
suggestion: Use labelValueText function for readonly aria-label to allow consumer customization.

finding: Disabled anchor link missing tabindex=-1. When href is set and disabled=true, the anchor may still be focusable in some browsers.
suggestion: Add tabindex=${this.disabled ? '-1' : nothing} to the anchor element.

finding: Disabled anchor link does not fully prevent keyboard activation. A keyboard user could still focus and attempt to activate it.
suggestion: Add tabindex=-1 to disabled anchor to fully remove it from keyboard tab order.

finding: Label property defaults to empty string, meaning groups without explicit labels will be announced as unnamed groups.
suggestion: Emit a devWarn when label is empty at firstUpdated.

finding: aria-expanded on the dropdown trigger uses nothing when closed, omitting the attribute entirely. Per WAI-ARIA APG menu button pattern, should be 'false' when closed.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${this._open ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: Primary action button uses this.ariaLabel which is not explicitly wired as a property, making it unreliable for Drupal Twig consumers who set aria-label as HTML attribute.
suggestion: Add an explicit @property for ariaLabel or use a dedicated property.

finding: Disabled link renders as span with role=link and tabindex=0. Pressing Enter does nothing but the element is announced as a link, confusing users.
suggestion: Remove tabindex=0 from disabled span or add keydown handler to prevent Enter and announce disabled state.

finding: Disabled span has role=link with tabindex=0. Disabled interactive elements with tabindex=0 is a debated pattern.
suggestion: Consider removing tabindex=0 from disabled span.

finding: Submenu parent buttons use aria-expanded with nothing when collapsed. Should be 'false' per WAI-ARIA APG disclosure pattern.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${isExpanded ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: Mobile toggle button uses aria-expanded with nothing when closed. Should always be 'true' or 'false'.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${this._mobileOpen ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: Space key on anchor items without children calls e.preventDefault(), blocking navigation. Items without children are <a> elements where Space should not be prevented.
suggestion: Do not prevent default on Space key for anchor items without children.

finding: All item clicks call e.preventDefault() unconditionally for leaf items, preventing native link navigation. Breaks progressive enhancement.
suggestion: For leaf items with href, allow native navigation and dispatch hx-nav-select as supplementary event.
statusReason: intentional SPA navigation pattern, removing preventDefault breaks consumer routing, product decision required

finding: Keyboard navigation reaches into child component shadow DOM via targetItem.shadowRoot?.querySelector('[part=link]'). Crosses shadow DOM encapsulation boundaries.
suggestion: Have hx-nav-item expose a public focus() method that delegates to its internal focusable element.

finding: Compliant. Uses nav landmark with aria-label, ordered list for semantics, aria-current=page, accessible ellipsis button, and JSON-LD structured data.
suggestion: none

finding: When label is empty, aria-label is omitted. The tablist has no accessible name fallback.
suggestion: Provide a fallback aria-label like 'Tabs' when label is empty.

finding: Panel aria-label uses tab.textContent which may include prefix/suffix slot content, producing labels like 'Settings 3'.
suggestion: Extract label from default slot text only, excluding prefix/suffix slot content.

finding: Compliant. Nav landmark with aria-label, aria-current=page, roving tabindex, aria-live polite region for page changes, localizable labels.
suggestion: none

finding: Current page button uses aria-disabled=true but is not natively disabled, so click handler still fires.
suggestion: Use native disabled attribute on current page button.

finding: The @property({ attribute: 'aria-label' }) causes dual announcement: both host element and inner div carry the aria-label.
suggestion: Set role=none on host element to prevent dual announcement, like hx-action-bar does.

finding: No keyboard navigation between steps at container level. Each hx-step has tabindex=0, creating excessive tab stops for long step lists.
suggestion: Implement roving tabindex: only active/current step has tabindex=0, others get tabindex=-1, with arrow keys to navigate.
statusReason: roving tabindex requires coordinated multi-file changes across hx-steps and hx-step, deferred to dedicated feature

finding: The step click target is a div with @click, not a button. While tabindex=0 and keydown are added, this is a div[role=listitem] acting as interactive without button role.
suggestion: Add role=button to the indicator area for proper interactivity announcement.

finding: Compliant. Exemplary ARIA toolbar: role=none on host, role=toolbar on inner div, roving tabindex with Home/End/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
suggestion: none

finding: When label is empty, aria-label defaults to generic 'Table' string. Not descriptive enough for pages with multiple tables.
suggestion: Require the label attribute and emit a visible console error when missing.

finding: Data rows with @click handler are clickable but have no role or keyboard activation. Rows are not focusable and cannot be activated via Enter/Space.
suggestion: Add role and Enter/Space activation on clickable rows, or document row click as mouse-only.

finding: When label and caption are both empty, the table has no accessible name. Screen readers cannot identify the table.
suggestion: Add devWarn when neither label nor caption is present.

finding: Component sets role='list'/role='listitem' but JSDoc describes 'description list for term/definition semantics'. Semantic mismatch between implementation and documentation.
suggestion: Either use native dl/dt/dd elements or update documentation to reflect actual list/listitem pattern.

finding: No accessible label for the list container. Multiple structured lists on a page cannot be distinguished by screen reader users.
suggestion: Add a label property and apply aria-label to the container.

finding: Compliant. Correct role=listbox for interactive mode, role=list for plain variants, keyboard navigation, and ARIA label enforcement.
suggestion: none

finding: In interactive mode, tabindex=0 on all non-disabled items creates multiple tab stops within the listbox. WAI-ARIA listbox pattern recommends roving tabindex.
suggestion: Implement roving tabindex: only active/focused item has tabindex=0.
statusReason: roving tabindex requires coordinated cross-component refactor across hx-list and hx-list-item

finding: Compliant. Excellent ARIA: role=tree/treeitem, aria-expanded/selected/level/posinset/setsize, roving tabindex, full keyboard navigation.
suggestion: none

finding: aria-multiselectable always rendered even when selection='none'. Should be omitted when tree does not support selection.
suggestion: Use nothing when selection is 'none'.

finding: aria-expanded is only rendered when expanded is true (uses nothing when false). Per WAI-ARIA APG Accordion pattern, must be 'false' when collapsed so screen readers announce the element as collapsible.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${this.expanded ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: When hxHref is set but hxAriaLabel is not provided, the interactive card (role=link) has no accessible name. DevWarn fires but no fallback in production.
suggestion: Fall back to a descriptive aria-label derived from hxHref when hxAriaLabel is not set.

finding: Space key activates role='link' cards. Per ARIA APG, links should only activate on Enter, not Space.
suggestion: Remove Space key activation for role='link' cards.

finding: No semantic grouping between value and label. Screen readers read them as separate text runs with no programmatic association.
suggestion: Wrap in role='group' with aria-label combining value and label.

finding: aria-live='polite' with aria-atomic='true' causes the animated value to be announced on every frame update during animation. Excessive screen reader verbosity.
suggestion: Only announce the final value via a separate live region updated at animation end.

finding: No accessible label for the counter. Numeric value alone is meaningless without context.
suggestion: Add a label property for aria-label so screen readers announce context.

finding: Compliant. Excellent: role=meter with aria-valuenow/min/max/valuetext, aria-labelledby, visible state labels, and native meter fallback.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. role=progressbar with valuenow/min/max/valuetext, label support, aria-describedby, completion live region, variant labels.
suggestion: none

finding: No aria-valuetext set. Screen readers will announce raw number without descriptive context like '75% complete'.
suggestion: Add aria-valuetext with descriptive string.

finding: Compliant. Comprehensive: role=alert/status, aria-hidden management, live region with microtask timing for JAWS/NVDA, severity labels, return-focus-to.
suggestion: none

finding: Unlike hx-alert, the banner does not include a visually-hidden severity label. Variant (info/success/warning/error) is conveyed only through color, violating WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color.
suggestion: Add a visually-hidden severity label matching the pattern in hx-alert._effectiveSeverityLabel.

finding: Compliant. role=img, dynamic aria-label, decorative guidance, pulse animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
suggestion: none

finding: Status conveyed primarily through color. Sighted color-blind users rely only on color differentiation between statuses.
suggestion: Consider adding optional visible text or distinct shapes per status.
statusReason: requires design system decision on distinct shapes per status

finding: Compliant. role=status with aria-label, decorative mode with role=presentation, prefers-reduced-motion respected.
suggestion: none

finding: Spinner does not set aria-busy or guide consumers to set it on the loading container.
suggestion: Document recommended pattern: consumers should set aria-busy=true on the loading container.

finding: Compliant. Layout primitive with role=presentation. No interactive elements.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Layout primitive with role=presentation and consumer override guard.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Pure layout primitive, transparent to assistive technologies.
suggestion: none

finding: Separator pattern compliant: role=separator with aria-valuenow/min/max, keyboard nav, aria-label.
suggestion: none

finding: Collapse buttons are 20x20px, below 44x44px WCAG 2.5.5 minimum touch target.
suggestion: Increase to min-width/min-height of 44px or add transparent hit-area padding.

finding: Non-decorative separator without label has no accessible name.
suggestion: Consider default aria-label or document the recommended pattern.

finding: Compliant. Semantic HTML elements via as property, title for truncated content.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Light DOM rendering preserves native HTML semantics.
suggestion: none

finding: Expand button aria-expanded uses nothing when collapsed. Should be 'false' per WAI-ARIA.
suggestion: Change to aria-expanded=${this._expanded ? 'true' : 'false'}.

finding: Copy button min-height is 32px and expand button min-width is 32px, below the 44x44px WCAG 2.5.5 touch target minimum.
suggestion: Increase min-width/min-height to 44px on both buttons.

finding: When alt is undefined and decorative is false, altText resolves to empty string. Informative image without alt is invisible to screen readers with no warning at render time.
suggestion: Add devWarn when !this.decorative && !this.alt. Consider visible fallback or aria-label='Image' as last resort.

finding: Error figure has both role='alert' and aria-live='polite'. Contradictory since role='alert' implies assertive.
suggestion: Remove aria-live='polite' or change to aria-live='assertive'.

finding: Compliant. Comprehensive accessible name strategy, dev warnings, badge validation, role=img management.
suggestion: none

finding: Remove button has no minimum width/height. Touch target far below 44x44px minimum.
suggestion: Add min-width/min-height of 44px to .badge__remove-button.

finding: Dot indicator without dotLabel is invisible to assistive technology. No runtime warning.
suggestion: Add devWarn when isDot is true and dotLabel is empty.

finding: Compliant. Contextual aria-label, semantic variant labels, native disabled on remove button.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Decorative=aria-hidden, labeled=role=img+aria-label+title, SVG sanitization, focusable=false.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. aria-hidden=true, role=presentation, hx-loaded event, prefers-reduced-motion respected.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. role=region, aria-roledescription=carousel, slide groups, pagination dots, live region, autoplay respects prefers-reduced-motion.
suggestion: none

finding: Live region toggles aria-live between 'polite' and 'off' dynamically. Some AT caches initial aria-live value.
suggestion: Use a separate off-screen element updated only during user-initiated navigation.
statusReason: aria-live toggle refactor requires significant restructuring

finding: Compliant. Theme announcements via role=status, high-contrast support, display:contents.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Standard visually-hidden technique, focusable variant with :focus-within visibility.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Cross-shadow-boundary ARIA bridging, label click delegation, error role=alert, ARIA skip for hx-* elements.
suggestion: none

finding: Shadow DOM label cannot use native for/id with light DOM inputs. Compensated with JS click handler and aria-label bridging.
suggestion: Document that consumers should prefer hx-field-label with aria-labelledby for most robust cross-boundary association.
statusReason: documentation recommendation only, no code change required

finding: Compliant. Required indicator with aria-hidden and visually-hidden text, span fallback for aria-labelledby.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Error=role=alert, warning/success=aria-live=polite, non-color indicators via SVG icons.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Error summary with role=alert, aria-invalid management, light DOM form semantics.
suggestion: none

finding: Error summary does not programmatically move focus after validation failure. Users may not notice the error summary appearing above their position.
suggestion: Call focus() on error summary element after validation failure.

finding: Compliant. Semantic <time> element with datetime attribute, Intl APIs for locale-aware formatting.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. role=switch, aria-checked, native button for keyboard. Enter handled natively.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. aria-pressed correctly reflects pressed state as true/false. Follows WAI-ARIA APG toggle button pattern.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Exemplary accessibility guard: suppresses render and emits devWarn when label is empty.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. aria-live for copy success, dynamic aria-label, sr-only class. Exemplary accessible feedback pattern.
suggestion: none

finding: Compliant. Mobile toggle uses aria-expanded with String() for correct true/false rendering.
suggestion: none
